name: Παραλία Λυγιάς
evidence: travelpreveza.gr: beach described as not fully organized, but businesses on the beach offer free sunbeds and umbrellas for their customers.

name: Δεή πλους
evidence: Visit Thesprotia/Tesoro: DEI beach in north Syvota has a bar with snacks/coffee and loungers and umbrellas for rent under the pines.

name: Μέγα Ντράφι
evidence: perdika.info: the first/largest section is organized — a canteen rents sunbeds and umbrellas and serves coffee/drinks.

name: Παραλία Έλενα
evidence: No source clearly describing an 'Elena' beach in Syvota/Plataria; only a Camping Elena reference, facilities unconfirmed.

name: Παραλία Γάτα
evidence: Visit Thesprotia: a picturesque canteen operates on the beach offering sunbeds in tree shade with coffee/snacks; elepod lists 'Παραλία Γάτα Beach Bar - Οργανωμένη Παραλία'.

name: Παραλία Καλάμι
evidence: Visit Thesprotia: the adjacent camping provides sunbeds where you can enjoy coffee/snacks (Kalami between Igoumenitsa and Plataria).

name: Παραλία Πλαταριάς
evidence: Official bathing-water profile: beach has umbrellas and sunbeds operated by the adjacent organized camping owner.

name: Σταυρολιμένας
evidence: Sources state the beach has no bar or restaurant and no organized sunbed services; you must go to Karavostasi or Arillas nearby.

name: Agni Beach
evidence: Multiple Corfu guides: three famous tavernas each offer sunbeds/umbrellas (primarily for diners); showers, toilets and beach bars listed.

name: Alipa beach
evidence: Lovin' Corfu and others: Alipa (Paleokastritsa harbor) is organized with sunbeds/umbrellas for rent, showers, and a bar-restaurant.

name: Alonaki Bay
evidence: Greeka/projectcorfu: entirely unorganized, no parasols or deck-chairs and no shops; only an occasional boat-canteen and a restaurant on the cliff above.

name: Benitses beach
evidence: Multiple guides: fully organized between marina and south end — sunbeds/umbrellas for rent, showers, several beach bars, water sports; Blue Flag.

name: Black Rocks Beach
evidence: Only source is the Black Rocks resort at Agios Gordios offering complimentary sunbeds exclusively to its guests; beach itself described as completely undeveloped — public organization unconfirmed.

name: Glyfa Beach
evidence: SuperTravel/projectcorfu: Glyfa (between Barbati and Nissaki, NE coast) has sunbeds & umbrellas, boat hire and a taverna restaurant.

name: Imerolia Beach
evidence: Greeka/mykerkyra: partly-organized shore with sunbed pairs and parasols for hire (~5 EUR/day per reviews).

name: Kaminaki Beach
evidence: Greeka/discover-corfu: partly-organized; the two beachfront tavernas provide sunbeds and umbrellas for hire (15-20 EUR/pair), plus boat hire.

name: Kanoni Beach
evidence: Name collision: Kanoni (Kassiopi) is fully organized with sunbeds and nearby beach bars, but there is also Kanoni at Corfu Town; could not confirm which our record refers to.

name: Paramonas
evidence: Greeka/discover-corfu: southern part partly organized — sunbeds and umbrellas for rent from the beachside tavern, public showers.

name: Καλυβιώτης
evidence: No sources found describing facilities at a Kalyviotis beach on Corfu.

name: Κρουζερή
evidence: Lovin' Corfu: Krouzeri (Katavolos, NE Corfu) is organized with sunbeds/umbrellas for rent, beach bars, restaurants, showers and water sports; Blue Flag.

name: Μανδράκι
evidence: Lovin' Corfu: no sunbeds for rent at Mandraki (Corfu Town, by the fortress); only toilets and a cafe inside the fortress.

name: Μώλος
evidence: Lovin' Corfu/discover-corfu: Molos (Lefkimmi Bay) is partly organized around the Attika Resort with sunbeds/umbrellas for rent, showers and a beach bar-restaurant; rest is unorganized.

name: Νότος
evidence: Greeka: Notos (SE Corfu) is partly organized — sun loungers, umbrellas and hammocks rented by a nearby tavern (~5 EUR per reviews).

name: Παραλία Άγιος Νικόλαος
evidence: Heavy name collision (Agios Nikolaos beaches in Crete/Zakynthos/Peloponnese dominate results); no Corfu-specific facility evidence found.

name: Παραλία Αχαράβης
evidence: Greeka/discover-corfu: central Acharavi is well organized — sunbeds and umbrellas for rent (~10 EUR/set) maintained by beach bars, tavernas and hotels; showers, shops.

name: Παραλία Λογγάς
evidence: Sources conflict: some say no sunbeds/umbrellas on the narrow beach, others mention a few for rent; taverna and cliff-top cafe-bar are above the beach, not on it.

name: Παραλία Παρακλάδι
evidence: Only generic geography sources found for Parakladi (Lefkimmi); no facility information.

name: Παραλία Μυρτιώτισσας
evidence: Greeka/discover-corfu: now partly-organized — sunbeds/umbrellas for 5 EUR each and a small cantina selling drinks and snacks; rest of the beach natural.

name: Σωτηριώτισσα
evidence: Lovin' Corfu: Sotiriotissa (Kontokali) is unorganized with no facilities or commercial activities — no sunbeds or umbrellas for rent.

name: Γουβιά
evidence: Discover Corfu/OnlyInCorfu: Gouvia beach is organized with sunbeds and umbrellas for rent, showers and toilets; tavernas/cafes/bars right behind the beach.

name: Γαλάζιο
evidence: beaches-searcher/allovergreece: Galazio (east Paxos) is untouched, boat-access only, with no amenities at all.

name: Δεύτερη Σπιάντζα
evidence: Only generic mentions of the small pebbly 'spiantzes' near Gaios; no facility evidence for this specific beach.

name: Πόρτο
evidence: Porto is Erikoussa's main port/settlement beach with accommodation nearby, but no source explicitly confirms sunbeds/beach bar on the beach.

name: Central Square Beach
evidence: No sources found for a 'Central Square' beach in Kefalonia; name likely informal/local.

name: Φτέρη
evidence: Multiple guides: Fteri is completely wild and by law free of any structures — no sunbeds, no beach bars, no facilities of any kind.

name: Αγία Παρασκευή
evidence: visitkefaloniaisland.gr/terrabook: Agia Paraskevi (between Sami and Agia Efimia) has organized spots with sunbeds and beach bars, plus the Agia Paraskevi Beach Restaurant.

name: Τραπεζάκι (γυμνιστών)
evidence: Naturist guides: the nudist SE end of Trapezaki is unorganized and informal, away from the main beach's sunbeds and facilities.

name: Άσπρος Βράχος
evidence: amazingkefalonia: White Rocks (Aspros Vrachos, Lassi) is a hidden beach reachable only from the sea — no facilities implied; no organized services reported.

name: Αγια Κυριακη
evidence: visitkefaloniaisland.gr: sunbeds, a canteen and water sports available at Agia Kyriaki (Zola area), with tavernas by the beach incl. 'Η ακρογιαλιά του Κώστα'.
